package.script: Ever wonder why your soda can feels ready to pop when you are flying high above the clouds? Here is the thing, it is all about invisible air pressure pushing from both the inside and the outside. Down on the ground, thick air pushes hard against the metal aluminum walls to keep everything stable. But as you climb way up into the sky, the surrounding air gets much thinner and weaker.
